description: Title of the standard Substitute following title for the existing title wherever it appears in the standard: 'Automotive Vehicles - Advance - Warning Triangles - Specifications' - 1.0 Page No. Nil, Introduction: Insert new paragraph after 4 th paragraph as follows: ' Further, since AIS-090: Approval of Retro-Reflective Markings for Heavy and Long vehicles, their Trailers and Semi-Trailers is now notified vide G.S.R. 784 (E) 12 th November 2008 for N category of vehicles including N3, w.e.f. 1 st April 2009 and that for M2 and M3 category vehicles w.e.f. from 1 st October 2009, the transitory provisions in this standard for alternate conspicuity markings for N3 category of vehicles complying to IS:14221-1995 needs to be standardized. The amendment No. 4 to this standard is to this effect.
